title: A failed last check is warned visibly on ranked offer cards
where: fixture QA harness (offline) and the deployed site (live production QA)
whatChanged: public/ui.js failedCheckNote() renders one short amber line ('Last check failed — showing the last successful observation.') under the money values of the best-offer card and of each ranked comparison card when quote.lastAttemptFailed is true; the attempt time, error and last successful check stay in 'Offer details and check history' and the footer keeps the failing-source diagnostics.
trigger: The production Worker received HTTP 403 for all three CoffeeMan product pages on the 00:17 UTC scheduled refresh while the same request succeeded from the runner, so the persisted CoffeeMan rows still rank their 15:51:52 UTC observations with lastAttemptFailed: true. Before this change a shopper saw the failure only inside the details/footer.
imageToolLimitation: The file-read tool rejects PNG input ('reading images is not supported'), so no image-based claim is made. The coarse character/pixel maps below are layout/colour-region evidence only and cannot establish that text is correct; every label and amount is corroborated by rendered DOM text and the API in the same browser session.
